==Hero Usage==
* Heroes only use this skill if they are within earshot of a spirit.

== Notes ==
* The target will still take damage even if the hex is not applied, e.g., when under the effects of [[Hex Breaker]].
* Spirits cannot be the target of this skill, yet will receive its damage if nearby a creature that has been targeted.

== Trivia ==
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] appears to be a female ritualist wearing [[Ritualist Canthan armor|Canthan armor]].
